title: Integral models
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and the separated finite-type $k$-scheme setting of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. All schemes below are Noetherian schemes in this setting. Let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite, with valuation ring $\cO_E$, uniformizer $\pi_E$, and residue field $\kappa_E=\cO_E/\pi_E$. Fix an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$.

Write $C_X=(\cO_E)_X$ for the constant coefficient sheaf and $R_X=\cO_{E,X}=p_X^*\underline{\cO_E}\cong\varprojlim_{n\ge1}(\cO_E/\pi_E^n)_X$ for the completed coefficient sheaf [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], [det-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x-integral-limit]. Write $D_R(X)=D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},R_X)$ and $D_C(X)=D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},C_X)$ for the derived categories [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. The categories $\Dbc(X,\Lambda)$ and $\Dctf(X,\Lambda)$ mean bounded complexes with constructible cohomology and their full subcategory of finite Tor amplitude [sk-def-sfb-constructible], [det-def-sfb-constructible-tor-amplitude]; derived completeness means that the canonical map to the derived limit of the reductions modulo $\pi_E^n$ is an isomorphism [sk-def-pe-derived-completion]. For constant coefficients use the same condition with $C_X$.

Let $\Dc(X,\cO_E)\subset D_C(X)$ consist of derived $\pi_E$-complete complexes $L$ for which $L\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{C_X}(\kappa_E)_X$ has constructible cohomology pulled back from $X_{\mathrm{ét}}$ and finite Tor dimension. This is the constant-coefficient category of [det-lem-integral-models-stacks]. Then $\Dctf(X,\cO_E)=\Dbc(X,\cO_E)$, and the following hold.

1. Restriction of scalars along $C_X\to R_X$ gives an equivalence between the derived $\pi_E$-complete objects of $D_R(X)$ and those of $D_C(X)$.
2. For $K\in D_R(X)$, $K\in\Dbc(X,\cO_E)$ if and only if $\operatorname{Res}K\in\Dc(X,\cO_E)$. Equivalently, $K$ lies in $\Dbc(X,\cO_E)$ precisely when it is derived complete and $K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{R_X}(\kappa_E)_X$ is a bounded constructible complex pulled back from $X_{\mathrm{ét}}$.
3. The categories $\Dbc(-,\cO_E)$ are preserved by the inverse image $f^*$ for every morphism $f:X\to Y$ in the setting, by $-\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{R_X}-$, and by $a_!=i_*u_!$ for every locally closed immersion $a=i\circ u:S\hookrightarrow\overline S\hookrightarrow X$, with $u$ open and $i$ closed. The inverse image and tensor functors are those of [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull] and [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]; open extension by zero is [sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek].
4. Every object of $\Dbc(X,E)$ is obtained by finitely many cones and shifts from objects $(a_!L_0)[1/\ell]$, where $a:S\hookrightarrow X$ is locally closed and $L_0$ is a lisse finite free $\cO_{E,S}$-module, meaning a module pro-étale locally isomorphic to a finite free coefficient module. Every object of $\Dbc(X,\Qlb)$ is obtained in the same way from objects $\QbarX\otimes_{\cO_{E,X}}a_!L_0$ for one finite subextension $E\subset\Qlb$ depending on the object; here $\QbarX=p_X^*\underline{\Qlb}$ uses [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed]. Moreover $a_!L_0\in\Dbc(X,\cO_E)$, and for every $n\ge1$ its derived reduction is $a_!(L_0/\pi_E^n)$, a bounded constructible complex with coefficients $\cO_E/\pi_E^n$ pulled back from $X_{\mathrm{ét}}$.

proof.text: Use localizingClosure_ctf_equals_bc to identify bounded constructibility with its finite-Tor intersection for the specified embedded integral ring.
Apply the embedded complete-restriction comparison for the complete category equivalence.
For each K use the embedded Stacks comparison for the first criterion. Compose it with the residue criterion using Iff.trans for the second criterion.

The integral operations theorem gives termwise exact inverse-image preservation. Cartesian coefficients supply finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation. The canonical left-derived/termwise comparison and isomorphism stability of bounded constructibility give the displayed total derived pullback assertion.
The second and third operations clauses give tensor preservation and open-then-closed extension by zero.
The three generator clauses give finite-E generation, single-finite-field Qbar generation, and the stated reductions of the same locally free lattice at every exponent.

theorem integral_models
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p ℓ : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    [CharP k p] (hℓp : ℓ ≠ p) (X : Scheme.{u})
    [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsNoetherian X] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (π : PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1)
    (hπ : Ideal.span {π} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1)) :
    ((constantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.1) X ⊓
        DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _) =
      constantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.1) X) ∧
    (∃ e : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IntegralModelsEmbedded.completedComplete ℓ E π X) ≌
        ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IntegralModelsEmbedded.constantComplete ℓ E π X),
      Nonempty (e.functor ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IntegralModelsEmbedded.constantComplete ℓ E π X) ≅
        ObjectProperty.ι (IntegralModelsEmbedded.completedComplete ℓ E π X) ⋙
          IntegralModelsEmbedded.restriction ℓ E X)) ∧
    (∀ K : DerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
        (integralCoefficientObject X ℓ E)),
      (constantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.1) X K ↔
        IntegralModelsEmbedded.stacksConstructible ℓ E π X
          ((IntegralModelsEmbedded.restriction ℓ E X).obj K)) ∧
      (constantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.1) X K ↔
        IntegralModelsEmbedded.completedComplete ℓ E π X K ∧
          integralModelResidueEtaleOrigin X ℓ E π K)) ∧
    (∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
      [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
      [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
      [IsNoetherian Y] (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
      (K : DerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1})
        (integralCoefficientObject Y ℓ E))),
      constantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.1) Y K →
      constantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.1) X
        ((CondensedRing.moduleObjectDerivedPullback (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.1)
          f).obj K)) ∧
    (∀ K M : DerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
        (integralCoefficientObject X ℓ E)),
      constantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.1) X K →
      constantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.1) X M →
      constantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.1) X
        (((CondensedRing.derivedTensor (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.1) X).obj K).obj M)) ∧
    (∀ (S V : Scheme.{u}) [S.Over (Spec (.of k))] [V.Over (Spec (.of k))]
      [LocallyOfFiniteType (S ↘ Spec (.of k))]
      [QuasiCompact (S ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (S ↘ Spec (.of k))]
      [LocallyOfFiniteType (V ↘ Spec (.of k))]
      [QuasiCompact (V ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (V ↘ Spec (.of k))]
      [IsNoetherian S] [IsNoetherian V] (j : S ⟶ V) (i : V ⟶ X)
      [j.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [i.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
      [IsOpenImmersion j] [IsClosedImmersion i]
      (L : DerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology S) Ab.{u + 1})
        (integralCoefficientObject S ℓ E))),
      constantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.1) S L →
      constantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.1) X
        ((CondensedRing.moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.1)
          i).obj (((CondensedRing.openImmersionLowerShriek
            (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.1) j).mapDerivedCategory).obj L))) ∧
    (∀ K : DerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
        (finiteCoefficientObject X ℓ E)),
      constantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E.1) X K →
      (sInf {P | integralModelGenerator X ℓ E ≤ P ∧ P.IsTriangulated ∧
        P.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms}) K) ∧
    (∀ K : DerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
        (qlbarCoefficientObject X ℓ)),
      constantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) X K →
      ∃ E' : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ,
        (sInf {P | qlbarModelGenerator X ℓ E' ≤ P ∧ P.IsTriangulated ∧
          P.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms}) K) ∧
    (∀ (S V : Scheme.{u}) [S.Over (Spec (.of k))] [V.Over (Spec (.of k))]
      [LocallyOfFiniteType (S ↘ Spec (.of k))]
      [QuasiCompact (S ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (S ↘ Spec (.of k))]
      [LocallyOfFiniteType (V ↘ Spec (.of k))]
      [QuasiCompact (V ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (V ↘ Spec (.of k))]
      [IsNoetherian S] [IsNoetherian V] (j : S ⟶ V) (i : V ⟶ X)
      [j.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [i.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
      [IsOpenImmersion j] [IsClosedImmersion i]
      (L₀ : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology S) Ab.{u + 1})
        (integralCoefficientObject S ℓ E)),
      CondensedRing.LocallyFree (integralCoefficientObject S ℓ E) L₀ →
      integralReductionHasEtaleOrigin X ℓ E π j i L₀)

reviewed_lean.note: Item correct (H3): ℓ prime, char k = p > 0 with p ≠ ℓ, X separated of finite type over k, E/Q_ℓ finite in an independent universe.
